existing_dispatch_suitability.streaming-etl-soak.yml: UNSUITABLE: Docker campaign lifecycle, global serial concurrency group, collection depends on prepare; static requires a named persistent runner
existing_dispatch_suitability.streaming-etl-soak-segment.yml: UNSUITABLE: workflow_call only; observes existing long-running campaign and requires persistent runner
existing_dispatch_suitability.streaming-etl-soak-cleanup.yml: EXCLUDED: deletes explicitly selected campaign resources

proposed_probe.trigger: workflow_dispatch only, root coordinates reviewed source ref
proposed_probe.jobs: Two independent bounded jobs, no needs between them; selectors anacreon-runners twice or explicitly ARC plus [self-hosted,Linux,X64]. Distinct runners/hosts never assumed.
proposed_probe.bounds: No checkout, dependency installation, Docker, SSH, tunnel, production endpoint mutation, network scanning or historical campaign commands. Per-job timeout 3 minutes; 5-second start/end sampling interval.
proposed_probe.identity: Per-run domain-separated SHA-256(salt || raw identifier) for /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id and /etc/machine-id; salt includes repository/run_id/attempt. Missing/empty identifiers produce available=false, never an empty-ID equality.
proposed_probe.output: Only hashes, presence booleans, run_id, run_attempt, job key, UTC sampling bounds. Attach actual numeric runner/job IDs via Actions jobs API afterward. Never print raw IDs, hostname, IP, environment, credentials or secrets.
proposed_probe.comparison: Require overlapping sampling/job intervals. Report same_observed_boot_id, same_observed_machine_id and namespace ambiguity. Different runner IDs or names do not establish independent physical machines.
proposed_probe.network: NOT_RUN_NO_APPROVED_TARGET. Can report only bounded boolean TCP reachability to an existing allowlisted private service supplied through a secret; that proves service connectivity only. Direct peer reachability needs an approved private rendezvous/endpoint exchange which does not publish plaintext addresses.

blockers: No safe existing dispatch-only two-job identity/reachability workflow.
Current org/repo runner inventory/capacity/labels are not inspectable with this integration.
No approved private peer endpoint/rendezvous was found; no direct cross-host reachability measured.
Kernel boot ID and machine ID may be container/namespace scoped; comparisons are discovery signals, not verified host/death authority.
Two jobs alone do not prove verified-stop or cross-host replacement; real positive-death and stale-owner acceptance remains separate.
scan_limits: Known incompatible workflows excluded; this is targeted workflow/tool metadata inspection, not an exhaustive skill or infrastructure scan.
